posts.content_md:
I recently completed the one kilometre art hologram Hololujah (1 kilometre x 3.5 cm) that was exhibited in February at Gallery M in South Australia. Info and images can be seen on my website: [http://zipsisterholography.com/hololujah.html](http://zipsisterholography.com/hololujah.html) I'll be attending the ISDH at MIT to deliver a paper about the production and aesthetics of the hologram. Look forward to seeing old friends there and some new ones.

Dave Warren
